programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: In 1693, an unprecedented earthquake hit the Valley of Noto destroying several small towns such as Modica, Ragusa and Scicli, which were all included in the Norman Kingdom of Sicili. More than 90,000 lives were lost. Giuseppe Lanza, the Spanish appointed viceroy, took charge of the reconstruction of the area. He called on Sicilian architects Giovanni Baptista, Vaccarini and Rosario Gagliardi.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: Explore the Bauhaus Legacy in Dessau, Germany. The Bauhaus is the 20th century’s most influential art, architecture, and design school that inspired a mindset and style known as Modernism. Join The Design Tourist Karen LeBlanc as she visits iconic Bauhaus Buildings earning Dessau a UNESCO World Heritage Site designation. The industrial city in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt holds the world’s largest collection of Bauhaus buildings. Much of the city’s Bauhaus architecture traces back to The Bauhaus School, which relocated to Dessau from Weimar in 1925.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.desc: Explore Erfurt, the capital city of the German state of Thuringia. During medieval times, a major trade route ran through Erfurt, shaping its history, culture and commerce. Join The Design Tourist Karen LeBlanc as she shops the Merchant’s Bridge, the city’s iconic covered bridge lined with the workshops of craftspeople, preserving time-honored traditions that connect to the past with a present-day appreciation of objects made with meaning, passion, and patience. Germany is the birthplace of the Bauhaus a revolutionary school of art, architecture, and design that thrived in the 1920s and 30s, becoming the trailblazer for present-day modernism. The influence of the Bauhaus is worldwide, including right here in Erfurt, reflected in the many handicrafts for sale.

programme.sub-title: Iceland Adventure: A Journey to the Paths Less Traveled Part 1
programme.desc: In this episode of The Design Tourist, travel journalist Karen LeBlanc explores Iceland off the beaten path, away from the country's famously crowded tourist attractions. Learn why Husafell is the ideal location for spotting the Northern Lights and experiencing Iceland's culinary culture.

programme.title: The Design Tourist
programme.sub-title: Valencia, Spain: Where the Silk Road Leads to a World Design Capital
programme.desc: Valencia, Spain has many claims to fame: the birthplace of paella, the growers of Valencia oranges, the cradle of ceramics production, a World Design Capital, and the 2024 European Green Capital. programme.sub-title: Curious Cuba: Exploring Havana with The Design Tourist
programme.desc: Join travel journalist Karen LeBlanc, The Design Tourist, as she explores the authentic soul of Cuba—from vintage cars and Hemingway’s haunts to Havana’s thriving art scene and Santeria rituals. Learn how Cuba's cultural quirks, resilient spirit, and emerging creative class are redefining life post-revolution. Whether you're curious about Cuban cuisine, UNESCO heritage sites, or modern entrepreneurialism, this immersive travel story reveals it all.
